title: Interview with Karen Bandeen-Roche
content:
Abstract
Gerontologist and statistician Karen Bandeen-Roche has spent decades formulating a framework for diagnosing frailty and predicting resilience in older adults, informing interventions to help stave off frailty and improving clinical outcomes from medical procedures. She speaks to Anna Demming about the “highly multidimensional, complex measurement problems” that arise.
